document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: Children today see thousands of adverts every year, not only between television programmes but also inside the games and videos they watch on their phones. I strongly agree that advertising aimed at young children should be banned, although I believe that clear rules, rather than a total ban, are sufficient for teenagers.

The main argument for a ban is that young children cannot recognise advertising for what it is. Until the age of about eight, many of them treat an advert as simply another piece of entertainment and accept its claims without question. A cartoon character praising a breakfast cereal is, for them, simply telling the truth. Using persuasive techniques on such an audience is fundamentally unfair, in the same way that it would be unfair to sign a contract with a child.

This unfairness also has harmful consequences. Adverts for sugary snacks and fast food contribute to poor eating habits, while in-app promotions encourage children to spend their parents’ money on virtual items. Moreover, constant exposure to new products creates pressure within families, as children demand whatever their friends already own.

Admittedly, teenagers are a different case. By the age of fourteen or fifteen, most young people understand the purpose of advertising, and a complete ban would be almost impossible to enforce on the platforms they use. For this age group, strict rules on honest content and on unhealthy products would be a more realistic solution.

In conclusion, advertising should not be allowed to target young children, who cannot judge it critically and are easily influenced by it. For older teenagers, however, careful regulation is a better answer than an outright ban.

note.en: The pair not only … but also stresses the scale: adverts are everywhere.
note.kk: not only … but also жұбы ауқымды күшейтеді: жарнама барлық жерде.
note.ru: Пара not only … but also усиливает масштаб: реклама везде.

note.en: A concession inside the thesis: the limit of the position.
Makes clear what is proposed for teenagers.
note.ru: Уточняет, что именно предлагается для подростков.

note.en: The topic sentence of the main argument.
Introduces a comparison that clarifies the argument.
note.ru: Вводит сравнение, которое делает довод понятнее.

note.en: Places a second harm alongside the first.
Adds a third harm — to families.
Brings back the second part of the position.

strengths.en: The writer agrees for a specific age group, not in general — an exact answer to “To what extent”.
strengths.kk: Автор «жалпы» емес, нақты жасқа қатысты келіседі — бұл «To what extent» сұрағына дәл жауап.
strengths.ru: Автор согласен не «вообще», а для конкретного возраста — это точный ответ на «To what extent».
strengths.example: clear rules, rather than a total ban, are sufficient for teenagers

strengths.en: The contract comparison shows clearly why advertising to children is unfair.
strengths.kk: Келісімшартпен салыстыру балаларға арналған жарнаманың неге әділетсіз екенін түсінуге көмектеседі.
strengths.ru: Сравнение с договором помогает понять, почему реклама для детей несправедлива.
strengths.example: in the same way that it would be unfair to sign a contract with a child

strengths.en: Not just “advertising is harmful” but three clear harms with examples.
strengths.kk: «Жарнама зиянды» деген жалпы сөз емес, мысалдары бар үш түсінікті зиян.
strengths.ru: Не «реклама вредна», а три понятных вреда с примерами.
strengths.example: in-app promotions encourage children to spend their parents’ money on virtual items

strengths.en: The writer admits where a ban is not needed, so the position looks balanced.
strengths.kk: Автор тыйымның қай жерде қажет емес екенін мойындайды — ұстаным салмақты көрінеді.
strengths.ru: Автор признаёт, где запрет не нужен, — позиция выглядит взвешенной.

note.en: Introduction: the scale of the issue and a position with a clear limit — a ban for young children, rules for teenagers.
note.kk: Кіріспе: құбылыстың ауқымы және шекарасы айқын ұстаным — кішкентай балаларға тыйым, жасөспірімдерге ереже.
note.ru: Введение: масштаб явления и позиция с границей — запрет для маленьких детей, правила для подростков.

note.en: The main argument: young children cannot tell adverts from entertainment. The comparison with a contract makes it vivid.
note.kk: Басты дәлел: кішкентай балалар жарнаманы ойын-сауықтан ажырата алмайды. Келісімшартпен салыстыру дәлелді көрнекі етеді.
note.ru: Главный довод: маленькие дети не отличают рекламу от развлечения. Сравнение с договором делает довод наглядным.

note.en: Consequences: eating habits, in-game spending, pressure on families — three concrete harms.
note.kk: Салдарлар: тамақтану, ойындағы шығын, отбасына қысым — үш нақты зиян.
note.ru: Последствия: питание, траты в играх, давление на семью — три конкретных вреда.

note.en: Concession: teenagers need no full ban, and it would not work — hence a “mostly agree” position.
note.kk: Мойындау: жасөспірімдерге толық тыйым керек емес әрі нәтиже бермейді — сондықтан ұстаным «негізінен келісемін».
note.ru: Уступка: для подростков полный запрет не нужен и не сработает — поэтому позиция «в основном согласен».

note.en: The conclusion restates both parts of the position in new words.
note.kk: Қорытынды ұстанымның екі бөлігін басқа сөздермен қайталайды.
note.ru: Вывод повторяет обе части позиции другими словами.

document.title: Advertising aimed at children
document.question:
Advertising aimed at children, such as adverts for toys, snacks and mobile games, is now common on television and online. Some people believe that this kind of advertising should be completely banned.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
